titolo: Green Tea Scent Spray | Elizabeth Arden
ld:
WHO IT'S FOR

Fragrance fans and lovers of Green Tea perfumes seeking a refreshing, energizing scent
People of all ages searching for a signature uplifting scent

WHAT IT IS

This invigorating vegan fragrance is a lush and green olfactory journey designed to awaken your senses with every spritz.

WHAT IT DOES


This lush, green fragrance energizes and excites the senses with sparkling note of bergamot, lemon, green tea and oakmoss to create an uplifting experience that lingers.


PROVEN RESULTS

Elizabeth Arden fragrances are fresh and feminine homages to the many facets of women. Each scent is a creative expression of the perfumer's art and an individual statement of allure.
This perfume is one of our best gifts to give.

HOW TO APPLY

Spritz on pulse points and all over to awaken your senses and for a refreshing burst of energy, the perfect touch to feel confident and energized throughout your day.
